# superset_annotation_layer (Data Source)

Looks up an annotation layer by its name, for example to add annotations to a layer that is not managed by Terraform. Layer names are not unique in Superset: the lookup fails when no layer matches, or when several do.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_annotation_layer" "releases" {
  name = "Releases"
}

resource "superset_annotation" "v2" {
  layer_id    = data.superset_annotation_layer.releases.id
  short_descr = "v2.0.0"
  start_dttm  = "2026-03-01T09:00:00"
  end_dttm    = "2026-03-01T09:00:00"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the layer. The comparison is exact.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the layer.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the layer, for `superset_annotation.layer_id`.
